verification.ordinaryNodeFetch: Failed with UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE because the server omitted its issuer intermediate.
verification.supplementedFetch: Succeeded using backend/parcels/https-json-fetch.js, which constructs an HTTPS Agent with Node built-in rootCertificates plus the AIA intermediate and rejectUnauthorized:true.
verification.conclusion: The server certificate validates to a root already trusted by Node when the published intermediate is supplied. No validation bypass or untrusted root was used.
verification.chainPath: Durban leaf -> Sectigo Public Server Authentication CA DV R36 (AIA intermediate) -> Sectigo Public Server Authentication Root R46 (Node built-in trust store).

service.name: eThekwini EXT Cadastral — Parcels layer
service.format: ArcGIS GeoJSON (f=geojson); Esri JSON and GeoJSON are declared supported formats.
service.nativeSpatialReference: WG31 / GCS_Hartebeesthoek_1994 custom WKT from service; metre units, Transverse Mercator, central meridian 31°, scale 1, false easting/northing 0.
service.metricSridBasis: The service WKT matches ESRI:102568 Hartebeesthoek94 Lo31 (E-N); verify equivalence in the runtime projection library before configuring. The service itself provides outSR=4326.
service.candidateNativeKey: GlobalID is the leading durable key candidate by field type; PROPERTYID is the cadastral identifier candidate and PROPKEY an additional native integer. Verify uniqueness, null rates and exact reads before runtime use. OBJECTID is the service row ID, not a demonstrated durable cadastral key.
service.scopeAssessment: Verified sample is central Durban/eThekwini only. Service extent is broad; this does not establish municipality-wide completeness or national scope.

boundedSample.method: GET using source-scoped verified HTTPS helper
boundedSample.assessment: Verified sample: three closed-ring cadastral parcel polygons with three distinct PROPERTYID, PROPKEY and GlobalID values. No broader uniqueness or exact-ID check performed.
